ceu: ✦ The sextile between Mercury and Saturn

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: The Moon passes through your area of conversations: messages, calls and quick meetings set the pace of the day.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, friendships and your image: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Let things flow without forcing them.
With Mars retrograde in your daily routine sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Ask the question you are embarrassed to ask: the answer may surprise you.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: Today the Moon asks for stability: whatever gives you security, be it money, home or affection, carries more weight.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your career and your inner life: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
With Mars retrograde in your romance sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Before buying, wait twenty-four hours and see if you still want it.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: The Moon in your sign asks you to put yourself at the centre of the day. It is not selfishness: it is recharging so you can give more to others.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your horizons and friendships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
With Mars retrograde in your home and family sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Write down three of your qualities and read them out loud.

t: The Moon asks you to close cycles calmly before starting new ones. Tidy up on the inside.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your career: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
With Mars retrograde in your communication sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Light some incense or a candle and breathe deeply.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, relationships and your horizons: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
With Mars retrograde in your money sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, routine and intimacy: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
With Mars retrograde in your self-image sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, romance and relationships: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
With Mars retrograde in your inner life sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, family and routine: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
With Mars retrograde in your friendship sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, conversations and romance: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. An idea from today could become a real project.
With Mars retrograde in your career sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, money and family: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
With Mars retrograde in your horizons sector, frustration fades when you change the way you act.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your image and conversations: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. Smile more: kindness opens paths today.
With Mars retrograde in your intimacy sector, channel your energy into finishing what you started.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.

The sextile between Mercury and Saturn brings together, in your favour, your inner life and money: Mercury brings ideas and words, Saturn brings discipline and responsibility. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
With Mars retrograde in your relationships sector, haste holds you back more than it helps, so review your strategy.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.
